title: Letter grades
hints: Check the invalid range first, then test thresholds from the highest down, so each branch only has to compare against one boundary.
Go's if needs braces but no parentheses: if score >= 90 { … } else if score >= 80 { … }. Watch >= versus > at exactly 90, 80, 70 and 60.
if score < 0 || score > 100 { return "invalid" }, then return "A" for >= 90, "B" for >= 80, "C" for >= 70, "D" for >= 60, and "F" otherwise.
